title: reservations.yaml
description: The traveller's own bookings, written only by record-reservation. Each entry is matched to the plan at render and gate time (scripts/reservation.py::match): a stop by date + poi_id (+ time), a move by date + from + to, a stay by its check-in date + lodging id. The booking number (ref) lives only here; every renderer masks it.

time.description: Only to tell two visits to the same place on one day apart.

lodging.description: The lodging POI id; date is the check-in date.

status.description: booked 已訂 / todo 還要訂 / none 不用訂 / self 自理 (meals only).

ref.description: Booking number. Never rendered in full.
